name: plenipo-agents
description: The outer harness for building AI-first products on the Plenipo platform. Five loop-scoped plugins: harness (always-on control plane — platform contract, runbook knowledge, config, validation, the conductor), scout (find an unclaimed industry worth a product), define (research -> spec -> plan -> GitHub backlog), shape (module, tool, permission and connector design + ADRs), and deliver (issue-driven build plus the run -> observe -> fix -> lock-in verification loop). Enable per loop to keep context minimal.
